messages:
Aurora Vega: Hey all 1st day at Redwood! I'm on UX/design tooling. Quick checklist q's: 1) do we get a Mac or can I request a Linux box? 2) who do I see for badge pickup? 3) how do I get access to the prototype Figma files and private design repo?

Sam (IT): Welcome Aurora 389 For design, Macs are standard but we can provision a Linux devbox if you need native Linux. If you want a Mac, reply with your shipping address and well start the order. For badge pickup, please fill this short form: https://redwood.intranet/forms/badge-pickup and select "HQ reception".

Aurora Vega: Thanks! I'll take a Mac. Shipping address DM'd. Also can someone add me to the design Figma team?

Ivy Li: Hey Aurora 44b I manage design access. Added you to the Figma team and sent an invite for the project called "Product UX". For the private repo (design tokens + helper scripts) follow these steps:

1) generate SSH key: `ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C \"aurora@redwood.com\"`
2) paste the public key at https://redwood.github.io/ssh-keys
3) request access to `redwood/design-system` via the internal access UI

If you run into permission denied, mention me and I'll approve.

Carlos (People Ops): Quick HR note: you're on the onboarding checklist. Benefits emails should hit your inbox. Also we're running a small "welcome lunch" on Thursday at 12pm in the HQ kitchen 37d37d bring any dietary notes to me.

Aurora Vega: Love lunch! I'm vegetarian and have a mild nut allergy. Also, tiny thing: are there stickers? I like minimal tech stickers.

Sam (IT): Sticker stock: minimal tech + plant emojis available 338 I'll also drop a short guide here for MDM enrollment on Mac:

```
# enroll Mac in Company MDM
open /Applications/RedwoodMDM/Enroll.app
# if installer blocked, run sudo installer -pkg /tmp/RedwoodMDM.pkg -target /
```

Ping me if you hit any blocker. I'll start the Mac order now.

BuddyBot: Aurora Vega was added to #design and #eng-design-collab. :tada:

Ivy Li: If you want, we can pair tomorrow at 10:30am PT to walk through the design system repo and local token workflow. Short screen share, 30m.

Aurora Vega: That would be perfect 60a Thanks so much everyone, excited to be here!
